question: What is the most laps f1 races had? Name the race, year and circuit location where the races with most laps was hosted.
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1, c2, c3 FROM (SELECT T3.lap AS c0, T2.name AS c1, T2.year AS c2, T1.location AS c3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T3.lap DESC) AS __r FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T3.lap, T2.name, T2.year, T1.location FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId ORDER BY T3.lap DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: Find every race (name, year, and circuit location) whose maximum number of laps completed in the results table equals the overall highest lap count across all races, including all races tied for that highest lap count
b.sql: SELECT r.name, r.year, c.location FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId HAVING MAX(res.laps) = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM results)

d.request: What is the most laps Formula 1 races have had? Name the race, year, and circuit location of the race(s) with the most laps, and if several races tie for the most laps, return all of them.
d.sql: WITH race_laps AS (SELECT raceId, MAX(laps) AS total_laps FROM results GROUP BY raceId) SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.year, c.location, rl.total_laps FROM race_laps rl JOIN races r ON r.raceId = rl.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE rl.total_laps = (SELECT MAX(total_laps) FROM race_laps)

c.request:
What is the most laps f1 races had? Name the race, year and circuit location where the races with most laps was hosted.
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: SELECT r.name, r.year, c.location, MAX(res.laps) AS laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId HAVING MAX(res.laps) = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM results)
